rationale: Although the text mentions a state regulatory moratorium on new utility water connections tied to an allocation permit, the text and ProQuest metadata show this is a short local newspaper news dispatch reporting a recent announcement ("was notified Wednesday") with quotes from a local realtor and utility spokesperson, rather than an empirical research study or systematic review (fails Criterion 3; E05/E12).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both the narrow rule-type reading and the plain Criterion 2 reading result in exclusion because the record is a brief journalistic news article rather than an empirical study or systematic review (Criterion 3).

evidence_quotes.quote: The water company was notified Wednesday that the DEP had lifted the moratorium against new connections effective immediately, said United Water spokesman Richard Henning.
The DEP had banned new connections to the utility's system after the water company exceeded its allocation permit in 2001, 2002 and 2004.
